說明: 《畫海人》補給、道具與素材的圖示。名稱是「物_」加上名稱（素材＝data.js 的 MATS；補給＝糧、燈油、墨水、藥草、海靈露、醒神香；另有銀貝、圖紙、藏寶圖碎片、第六頁殘片等）。存成 img/item/名稱.webp（256×256，透明背景）。

style.item: Anime film game item icon: exactly one object, centred, filling about two thirds of the frame, seen from a slight three-quarter angle, in the same hand-painted anime film style as the game's scenes: clean crisp line art, cel shading, soft painterly highlights. Medieval European setting. Draw only the object described: a natural material stays plain and natural, with no added jewellery, amulets, metal fittings, gems or decorations. Bright, clear true colours with a soft rim light so it reads at small size; a muted base palette with warm highlights. Nothing else in the frame: no hands, no people, no table, no scenery, no frame, no border. No text, letters or numbers anywhere; any writing is drawn as abstract squiggles. Isolated on a fully transparent background.
